rule: capability debt: lessons that have already recurred first, then no tool at all before tool-not-wired, then oldest; then skills by rank: misaligned or absent litmus answer, then median under aligned, then open findings, then never used

items.section: outcome eval of the folded skills

target.sharper_check: outcome graders kept in the scratchpad until the deliverables are written
target.target: the sharper_check names a tool under tools/ that exists, that tools/phase.py runs, and that has a self-test gate beside it proving it can fail
target.stop: named tool is wired into phase.py GATES and has a self-test gate proving it can fail
